name: Create a Page in Notion
description: Create a new page in a Notion database or as a child of another page. Supports setting database properties and adding content blocks.

parentType.description: 'database' to create a page in a database, or 'page' to create a sub-page

parentId.description: Database ID or parent page ID

properties.description: Database properties (for database parent). Example: {"Status": {"select": {"name": "In Progress"}}}

content.description: Plain text content to add as a paragraph block

children.description: Array of Notion block objects. Overrides 'content' if provided.
